policy.scope: Library model/renderer selection, navigation, query handoff, editor guards and recoverable Trash. Real pane focus, native control activation, dialogs, system clipboard paste and installers have separate mandatory native acceptance. The Mac adapter runs actual LibraryModel/LibraryStore entry points; callback intent is not proof of physical focus.

nativeExceptions.reason: Native platform modifier conventions, identical actions and outcomes.

policy.searchHandoff: Set pending search and immediately enter content before any debounce delay; the entry point must commit the latest query, await its real completion and select its first result.
policy.scopeAction: Change the scope and explicitly enter content, matching keyboard Sidebar Enter/Right.
policy.editingKeys: Pass through to the native editor without changing item selection, pin state or Trash. Native typing/undo and caret remain separately tested.
